description: Indicadores de uso y conectividad de zonas WiFi gratuitas en Risaralda is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. Este conjunto de datos contiene información estadística y geográfica relacionada con el uso y funcionamiento de las zonas WiFi gratuitas ubicadas en el departamento de Risaralda. Incluye indicadores asociados a conectividad, número de conexiones, tiempo de uso, zonas visitadas y comportamiento general del servicio. Coverage: Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. Its tags are acceso a internet, conectividad, wifi gratis. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2026-05-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
